description: This file contains functions for calculating MCS and TBS for uplink and downlink channels in 5G NR, including effective code rate validation, TBS calculation, and MCS adjustment to meet rate constraints. It references specific 3GPP specifications and project-specific modules related to scheduling, UCI, and PUSCH/PDCH configurations.

methods.name: build_ulsch_info
methods.description: Constructs ULSCH configuration object with parameters for effective code rate calculation.

methods.name: update_ulsch_info
methods.description: Updates ULSCH configuration with TBS and MCS information.

methods.name: calculate_min_uci_bits
methods.description: Calculates minimum rate-matched bits needed for UCI messages based on payload and configuration.

methods.name: is_pusch_effective_rate_valid
methods.description: Validates if the effective code rate for PUSCH meets maximum supported rate and other constraints.
